en-US.description: PulseSoc is a social platform for creating, learning, and connecting through posts, videos, reels, messages, notifications, profiles, reporting, blocking, and community discovery. With PulseSoc, users can follow creators, explore video content, check notifications, manage their profile, and stay connected through direct messages. PulseSoc is operated by CoinPilotXAI Inc. and is built around user control, moderation, privacy-aware design, and clear communication. PulseSoc is not financial, investment, legal, or betting advice. Paid digital access is not available in this iOS build until Apple In-App Purchase support is implemented and approved.
en-US.promoText: PulseSoc brings social posting, reels, videos, messaging, notifications, reporting, blocking, and core community tools into one mobile-first experience.
en-US.title: PulseSoc
en-US.subtitle: Create, connect, stay aware

review.notes:
PulseSoc is a native iOS social platform for https://pulsesoc.com, with feed, reels, live video, messaging, and marketplace built as native React Native screens.

The demo account password is supplied in the App Review Information section of App Store Connect. It is deliberately not stored in this file.

Guideline 2.1 - expired subscription demo account:
This demo account has a previously expired PulseSoc Premium subscription and currently has no active Premium entitlement.

After signing in, please open the Premium section. The account will display its expired subscription state and provides access to the Monthly and Annual subscription options, Continue purchase flow, and Restore Purchases.

No additional authentication or manual approval is required.

In-app purchases:
Premium is sold exclusively through Apple In-App Purchase (com.pulsesoc.premium.monthly and com.pulsesoc.premium.annual). Continue starts the standard StoreKit purchase sheet and Restore Purchases uses StoreKit. The account's prior PulseSoc subscription was not an Apple transaction, so Restore will not report it as an active Apple entitlement.

Guideline 1.2 - User Generated Content safeguards:
- Terms/EULA and the PulseSoc no-tolerance UGC policy are presented before users register or log in.
- Users can flag objectionable content from post/profile safety menus. Reports create PulseSoc moderation records for review.
- Users can block abusive users from the profile More menu using Block User.
- Blocking immediately stops contact, hides/removes that user's activity from the blocker user's feed experience, and creates a moderation report so PulseSoc safety/admin staff are notified.
- PulseSoc targets moderation action within 24 hours where required for objectionable content or abusive behavior.

The iOS app supports login, signup, feed, posts, reels, videos, messages, notifications, profile, reporting, blocking, support, terms, privacy, and account settings.
